verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Google Calendar offers appointment booking pages, but the evidence only names that feature and never shows collective or multi-host scheduling that limits offered slots to times when every required host is free. The free/busy API only returns availability for a set of calendars, which a developer could build on, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can offer collective events that only show slots when every required host is free
